description_en: Updates the attributes of an egress proxy configuration
name: UpdateEgressProxyConfigurationAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

Note If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the client token. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端 Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符。

说明 若您未指定，则系统自动使用 API 请求的 RequestId 作为 ClientToken 标识。每次 API 请求的 RequestId 不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run and does not update the configuration. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会更新配置。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回 HTTP 2xx 状态码并直接执行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the egress proxy configuration
parameters.name: egress_proxy_configuration_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the egress proxy configuration. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with an uppercase or lowercase letter or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 出口配置的名称。长度为 2~128 个字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: egress_proxy_configuration_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the egress configuration. The value must be 2 to 256 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh: 出口配置的描述信息。长度为 2~256 个字符，可包含中文、字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en: The default action to be performed in the PostResponse phase (after a response is returned) when traffic does not match any rules. This phase supports only the Allow value (default), which allows the traffic to pass through
fields.help_zh: PostResponse 阶段（响应返回后）在流量未命中任何规则时执行的默认动作。该阶段仅支持取值 Allow（默认值），即允许通过
fields.name: post_response

fields.help_en:
The default action to be performed in the PreDns phase (before DNS resolution) when traffic does not match any rules. Valid values:

Allow: allows the traffic to pass through.

Deny: denies the traffic
fields.help_zh:
PreDns 阶段（DNS 解析前）在流量未命中任何规则时执行的默认动作。取值：

Allow：允许通过。

Deny：拒绝
fields.name: pre_dns

fields.help_en:
The default action to be performed in the PreRequest phase (before a request is forwarded) when traffic does not match any rules. Valid values:

Allow: allows the traffic to pass through.

Deny: denies the traffic
fields.help_zh:
PreRequest 阶段（请求转发前）在流量未命中任何规则时执行的默认动作。取值：

Allow：允许通过。

Deny：拒绝
fields.name: pre_request

parameters.help_en: The default actions to be performed in each effective phase (PreDns, PreRequest, and PostResponse) when traffic does not match any rules
parameters.help_zh: 各生效阶段（PreDns、PreRequest、PostResponse）在流量未命中任何规则时执行的默认动作
parameters.name: default_rule_phase_actions

fields.help_en: The ID of the egress proxy rule group
fields.name: egress_proxy_rule_group_id

fields.help_en: The priority of the egress proxy rule group in the egress proxy configuration. Valid values: 1 to 1000. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
fields.help_zh: 出口规则组在该出口配置中的优先级。取值范围为 1~1000，数值越小优先级越高
fields.name: priority

parameters.help_en: The list of referenced egress proxy rule groups
parameters.name: egress_proxy_rule_groups
